PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
 nDonationCount number;
 szSponsorName varchar2(50);
BEGIN
 :system.message_level := '10';
-- these values are for testing only
 --:parameter.p_sponsor_id := 'SPON033240';
 --:parameter.p_chapter_id := 'WAD';
 if :parameter.p_sponsor_id is null or
 :parameter.p_chapter_id is null then
 show_error('18023');
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;

 begin
 select name
 into szSponsorName
 from sponsors
 where chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id
 and sponsor_id = :parameter.p_sponsor_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 szSponsorName := null;
 end;

 clear_message;
 message('Collecting Statistics.....', no_acknowledge);
 --pitss synchronize;
 -- [Ver: 01 ]
 -- [Ver: 02 ] -- IM 8497
 -- [Ver: 03 ]-- Duplicate objects removal from GRP_LAF_STND
 
 -- [Ver : 02] -- 10/20/2017 -- IM 326 (valid_don_proc_codes at institutional level )
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 set_window_property('pop_window',
 title, :banner.prog_name || ' [Ver: 02 ] ' ||
 'ABO Breakdown for Sponsor - ' || szSponsorName ||
 '[' || :parameter.p_sponsor_id || ']'); 

 begin
 clear_message;
 message('Collecting Statistics.....', no_acknowledge);
 --pitss synchronize;

 select count(*)
 into nDonationCount
 from donations
 where drive_id in (select ds.drive_id
 from drive_sponsors ds, drives
 where ds.sponsor_id = :parameter.p_sponsor_id
 and drives.drive_id = ds.drive_id
 and drives.drive_date between add_months(sysdate, -18)

 and rownum < 4);

 show_error('12206');
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;
 end;

 populate_abo_information;
 compute_percentage;
 --pitss synchronize;
 redisplay;
 clear_message;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_ABO_INFORMATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_abo_information IS

 cursor cur_drives is
 select drives.drive_date, drives.drive_id
 from drive_sponsors ds, drives
 where ds.sponsor_id = :parameter.p_sponsor_id
 and drives.drive_id = ds.drive_id
 and drives.drive_date between add_months(sysdate, -18)
 and sysdate
 order by drives.drive_date desc;

 szDriveDate date;
 szDriveID varchar2(10) := null;
 szLabel varchar2(50) := null;
 nRow number;
 szDriveString varchar2(50) := null;
 q_str varchar2(1000);

BEGIN
 clear_message;
 message('Collecting Statistics.....', no_acknowledge);
 --pitss synchronize;

 populate_donation_types;
 --pitss synchronize;
 clear_list('ctrl_draw_stats.pl_selected_drives');

 open cur_drives;
 loop
 fetch cur_drives
 into szDriveDate, szDriveID;
 exit when cur_drives%notfound;
 nRow := cur_drives%rowcount;
 copy(szdriveid, 'ctrl_draw_stats.drivestring' || to_char(cur_drives%rowcount));
 szLabel := to_char(szDriveDate, 'MM-DD-YYYY') || ' ' || szDriveID;
 add_list_element('ctrl_draw_stats.pl_selected_drives',
 nRow,
 szLabel,
 to_char(nRow));
 if cur_drives%rowcount = 3 then
 exit;
 end if;
 end loop;
 if cur_drives%isopen then
 close cur_drives;
 end if;

-- synchronize;
 :ctrl_draw_stats.pl_donation_types := 'AL';
 :ctrl_draw_stats.pl_selected_drives := 1;
 --pitss synchronize;
 q_str := ' decode(chapter_id, ''ALL'', ' || in_quotes(:parameter.p_chapter_id) || ', chapter_id) = ' ||in_quotes(:parameter.p_chapter_id) || -- IM 326
 --' chapter_id = ' || in_quotes(:parameter.p_chapter_id) ||
 ' and procedure_code in ( select procedure_code from valid_proc_codes ' ||
 ' where sort_sequence < 100 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) )'||
 ' and donation_type = '|| 
 in_quotes(:ctrl_draw_stats.pl_donation_types);
 
 :ctrl_draw_stats.q_str := q_str;
 set_block_property('draw_stats', default_where,q_str);
 /*
 'chapter_id = ' || in_quotes(:parameter.p_chapter_id) ||
 ' and donation_type = ' ||
 in_quotes(:ctrl_draw_stats.pl_donation_types));
 */
 go_block('draw_stats');
 execute_query;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_DONATION_TYPES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_donation_types IS
 rg_name VARCHAR2(40) := 'donation_type'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 h_query varchar2(200);
 h_number number;
BEGIN
 /*
 ** must load information in the list item for donation type
 ** Make sure group doesn't already exist 
 */ 
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 

 /* 
 ** If it does not exist, create it and add the two necessary columns to it. 
 */ 
 IF Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 h_query := 'SELECT description, donation_type ';
 h_query := h_query || 'FROM valid_donation_types ';
 h_query := h_query || 'where sysdate between eff_date';
 h_query := h_query || ' and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 1) ';
 h_query := h_query || ' and sort_sequence < 100 ';

 rg_id := Create_Group_From_Query( rg_name, h_query);
 END IF; 
 /* 
 ** Populate the record group 
 */ 
 h_number := Populate_Group( rg_id ); 
 if h_number != 0 then
 message('Cannot access donation types from database.');
 end if;
 clear_list('ctrl_draw_stats.pl_donation_types');
 populate_list('ctrl_draw_stats.pl_donation_types', rg_id);
-- add_list_element('ctrl_draw_stats.pl_donation_types', 1, 'All Donation Types', 'ALL');
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DRAW_STATS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retrieve_draw_stats (p_don_type IN varchar2,
 p_proc_code IN varchar2) IS

 cursor cur_stat is
 select vmc.description, count(donations.donor_id)
 from donors, donations, valid_master_codes vmc
 where donations.donation_type = p_don_type
 and donations.procedure_code = p_proc_code
 and donors.donor_id = donations.donor_id
 and vmc.code = donors.blood_type
 and vmc.code_type = 'ABO'
 and ( donations.drive_id = nvl(:ctrl_draw_stats.drivestring1, 'NULL')
 OR donations.drive_id = nvl(:ctrl_draw_stats.drivestring2, 'NULL')
 OR donations.drive_id = nvl(:ctrl_draw_stats.drivestring3, 'NULL')
 )
 group by vmc.description;

 nRowWiseCount number := 0;
 szABODesc varchar2(50) := null;
 nABOCount number := 0;
 szItemName varchar2(32) := null;
 nTmpNum number := 0;
BEGIN
 open cur_stat;
 loop
 fetch cur_stat
 into szABODesc, nABOCount;
 exit when cur_stat%NOTFOUND;

 nRowWiseCount := nRowWiseCount + nABOCount;
 szItemName := 'draw_stats.' || upper(replace(rtrim(szABODesc), ' '));
 copy(to_char(nABOCount), szItemName);

 szItemName := upper('ctrl_draw_stats.total_' || replace(rtrim(szABODesc), ' '));
 nTmpNum := to_number(name_in(szItemName));
 copy(to_char(nABOCount + nTmpNum), szItemName);
 end loop;
 if cur_stat%isopen then
 close cur_stat;
 end if;
 :draw_stats.proc_count := nRowWiseCount;
 :ctrl_draw_stats.total_count := :ctrl_draw_stats.total_count + nRowWiseCount;
 --pitss synchronize;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMPUTE_PERCENTAGE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE compute_percentage IS
BEGIN
 if :ctrl_draw_stats.total_count > 0 then
 :ctrl_draw_stats.per_APOS := to_char(round( :ctrl_draw_stats.total_apos / 
 :ctrl_draw_stats.total_count * 100, 1)) || '%';
 :ctrl_draw_stats.per_BPOS := to_char(round( :ctrl_draw_stats.total_bpos / 
 :ctrl_draw_stats.total_count * 100, 1)) || '%';
 :ctrl_draw_stats.per_ABPOS := to_char(round( :ctrl_draw_stats.total_abpos / 
 :ctrl_draw_stats.total_count * 100, 1)) || '%';
 :ctrl_draw_stats.per_OPOS := to_char(round( :ctrl_draw_stats.total_opos / 
 :ctrl_draw_stats.total_count * 100, 1)) || '%';
 :ctrl_draw_stats.per_ANEG := to_char(round( :ctrl_draw_stats.total_aneg / 
 :ctrl_draw_stats.total_count * 100, 1)) || '%';
 :ctrl_draw_stats.per_BNEG := to_char(round( :ctrl_draw_stats.total_bneg / 
 :ctrl_draw_stats.total_count * 100, 1)) || '%';
 :ctrl_draw_stats.per_ABNEG := to_char(round( :ctrl_draw_stats.total_abneg / 
 :ctrl_draw_stats.total_count * 100, 1)) || '%';
 :ctrl_draw_stats.per_ONEG := to_char(round( :ctrl_draw_stats.total_oneg / 
 :ctrl_draw_stats.total_count * 100, 1)) || '%';
 :ctrl_draw_stats.per_NOABOTYPE := to_char(round( :ctrl_draw_stats.total_noabotype / 
 :ctrl_draw_stats.total_count * 100, 1)) || '%';
 end if;
 --pitss synchronize;
 redisplay;
END;
